| [FND-TIME-013](../../findings/FND-TIME-013.md) | The music driver install of 4734:0133 runs only while DS:3444 is not 0, and both the -L launch (through overlay 180) and bit 3 of SOUND.CFG word 0x14 store 0 there through 4734:0128, the word's one writer |
| [FND-TIME-014](../../findings/FND-TIME-014.md) | From program start to the start menu the installed launch clears DS:3444 twice, installs only the digital driver with no timer slot, and runs channel 0 at 10,000 µs until the first FLI and at 1,000 µs from then on, with no wait_ms call |
